purpose: Provide a non-circular source basis for the human-selected static-conformance disposition before the canonical architecture-design digest exists.
invariants: Program Kit-owned C# added or changed by implementation continues to satisfy the existing private C# source-quality gate.
Pull-request and merge-group workflow permissions, trigger coverage, combined-source checkout, and stable required-check behavior are executable workflow and conformance obligations.
Only a successful protected-main push run may produce a canonical package artifact eligible for publication.
A publication run consumes and verifies exact prebuilt package bytes and never rebuilds them.
Human approval semantics and execution-time byte evidence remain distinct and traceable.
